effective_date_basis: Effective date of the revoking or disposing instrument, or a current basis.
ending_pattern: Land reserved for lighthouse purposes: continues until revoked, transferred or disposed of as surplus. The consolidation of the Bureau of Lighthouses into the Coast Guard (Reorganization Plan No. II of 1939, s.2(a), effective July 1, 1939) is a continuity, not an end.

exceptions_savings.assessment: Transfers of jurisdiction carry the reservation forward. FLPMA (Pub. L. 94-579, Oct. 21, 1976) s.704(a) repealed the Pickett Act and implied withdrawal authority prospectively; s.701 saves existing withdrawals until modified under FLPMA or other law (IBLA, Grant L. Hacking, 1980). This is a continuity point, never an end; the s.204(l) review of withdrawals is a review lead, not an end.

exemplar.wpa_summary: E. 0. 4410 of Apr. 1,1926,reservingcertainlands in Alaska for lighthousepurposes,amended to redefinethe boundaries of said lands.

legal_effect: Research pattern only. A type rule never fills a judgment field, establishes an end, a date, a status or savings for any order, and never substitutes for reading the order's own text.
outlier_conditions: The order's own text (not only the WPA summary or APP title) does not match the type, or the held text is another order's.
The order does more than the type's single act (a second operative clause of another kind).
A later order or statute amends, extends, revokes or revives it before the candidate end.
The order states its own effective date, duration, condition or termination that differs from the pattern.
The order transfers a military reservation for lighthouse use (two orders' lifecycles).

The order only amends or modifies another order: its own operative effect merges into, and normally ends with, the parent order; read the parent's text and lifecycle. (The exemplar EO 5458 amends the description in EO 4410.)
The station was disposed of under surplus-property or lighthouse-preservation statutes, or conveyed to a state or nonprofit: the deed date is the end, with reversionary clauses as residuals.
Alaska statehood or other statutory transfers of the site.
quoted_clause:
October 1, 1930
Executive Order
Amending an Executive Order for the Withdrawal of Public Lands
Alaska
It is hereby directed that Executive Order No. 4410 of April 1, 1926, withdrawing
certain lands in Alaska for lighthouse purposes, be, and the same is hereby, amended
so as to describe the land in accordance with the official plat of survey to read:
Lot 3, sec. 26, T. 59 S., R. 79 E., Copper River meridian, containing 41.25 acres.
